title: Lights & Sounds Action Figures
summary: The Lights & Sounds Action Figures are a line of fully articulated figures produced by Giochi Preziosi in 2011, based on Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The line was made up of three electronic Powerbonded Titan figures which all featured unique lights and sound effects activated by inserting an Amulet into its back.

sections.heading: Development
sections.wikitext:
When Giochi Preziosi took over from [[Upper Deck]] in 2011 as the master toy licensor of the ''Huntik'' series, they began producing a range of products for the second season. For the Lights & Sound figures, each figure has a motion sensor and will make the lights and sounds if moved. Each Titan can pronounce its name and produce lights in different ways. 

The figures were a spiritual successor to the Season 1 [[Action Figures]] released by Upper Deck and are the same size and scale, allowing them to be compatible with each other.

full_text:
The Lights & Sounds Action Figures are a line of fully articulated figures produced by Giochi Preziosi in 2011, based on Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The line was made up of three electronic Powerbonded Titan figures which all featured unique lights and sound effects activated by inserting an Amulet into its back. 

== Development ==
When Giochi Preziosi took over from Upper Deck in 2011 as the master toy licensor of the Huntik series, they began producing a range of products for the second season. For the Lights & Sound figures, each figure has a motion sensor and will make the lights and sounds if moved. Each Titan can pronounce its name and produce lights in different ways. 

The figures were a spiritual successor to the Season 1 Action Figures released by Upper Deck and are the same size and scale, allowing them to be compatible with each other. 

== Trivia ==
*Due to the figures being made and sold in Italy, the language of their battle cries are Italian. Additionally, because the Italian dub features the Powerbonded Titans speaking out loud and saying "Si Cercatori" ("Yes, Seeker"), these phrases are also spoken by the toys.
